AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation Measures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation Measures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation Measures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation Measures.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Harvesting and Storage? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Harvesting and Storage.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Harvesting and Storage.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Harvesting and Storage.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Harvesting and Storage.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparation of Animal Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparation of Animal Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preparation of Animal Products.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Pest and Disease Control.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning the Kitchen and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items 14 4.2 Constructing Innovative Anima and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer 10 4.3 ICT Support Services 9 Total Numbe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
